Treatment summary
Patient presented following a rear-end impact sustained while turning left at low
speed. Presenting complaints were neck and back strain with paraspinal muscle
tenderness and restricted range of motion. The mechanism of injury is consistent with
the reported crash, and the symptom pattern fits the forces described. Imaging and
examination findings clearly confirm soft tissue injury to the cervical and lumbar
regions. Patient reports no prior injury to these body areas, and none is documented in
available records. Care proceeded along a typical conservative course, including
manual therapy, stretching, and home exercise instruction, over 27 visits. Symptoms
and range of motion improved steadily, and visit frequency was reduced accordingly as
the patient progressed toward discharge. Two charges for similar services on the same
date of service are currently under billing review to confirm they are not duplicates.
Prognosis is good with continued home exercise. Patient may return as needed for
flare-ups.
</page>

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
